Name: Cow Decal Barn Animal
Author: Campaigner
Description:
This is a very simple standalone barn animal mod that introduces a Cow Decal (the ever popular wall decoration) as a functional barn animal! You simply buy it from Marnie, and it grows up over five days like a normal cow. It can be milked for "Pretend Milk" (because why would a decal produce real milk?), and said "Pretend Milk" can be turned into "Pretend Cheese" just like normal cheese.

This was made entirely on a whim. I am not sorry.

Downloads.Description: Initial release. Purchase the Cow Decal animal from Marnie.
